name: RP2040-Zero
notes: A bare Waveshare RP2040-Zero, with nothing assigned. Not a blaster board: it is the module a board is built around, so this preset claims no pins and leaves every one of them to you.
Every GPIO the module brings out is on the diagram - GP0-GP15 and GP26-GP29 - so the console can tell you when a pin you have picked is not one of them.
